vulnerability.name: USN-5013-2
vulnerability.description: USN-5013-1 fixed several vulnerabilities in systemd. This update provides the corresponding update for Ubuntu 16.04 ESM.   Original advisory details:   It was discovered that systemd incorrectly handled certain mount paths. A  local attacker could possibly use this issue to cause systemd to crash,  resulting in a denial of service. (CVE-2021-33910)   Mitchell Frank discovered that systemd incorrectly handled DHCP FORCERENEW  packets. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to reconfigure  servers. (CVE-2020-13529)

statements.status_notes: Several security issues were fixed in systemd. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
